summary: Farmer and Kageneck gamekeeper at Stegen who bought the Jägerhof in Unteribental in 1751; of the same Heitzler family as John, exact kinship unknown.
bio: Josef Heitzler the elder was a farmer and gamekeeper in the service of the Kageneck family at Stegen. In 1751 he bought at auction the property in Unteribental that was later called the Jägerhof, and in the same year he married Katharina Schlupf, who was born at Kirchzarten in 1728 and died at Unteribental on 9 April 1809. The Jägerhof may be the same farm that Martin Begelspacher worked as the 'Jägerhofbauer'. Josef belonged to the same Heitzler family as John's ancestors, but his exact relationship to them is not known.
occupation: Bauer und Kageneck'scher Jäger in Stegen
